strings.Strata Monitor icon: a violet-to-mint ga: Strata Monitor icon: a violet-to-mint gauge ring around a pulse line
strings.A system monitor that lives in the macOS: A system monitor that lives in the macOS menu bar.
strings.CPU, GPU, memory, disk, network, battery: CPU, GPU, memory, disk, network, battery and devices, with the processes behind each reading.
strings.The menu bar item unfolding into CPU, ba: The menu bar item unfolding into CPU, battery and Wi-Fi readings, with hidden menu bar items appearing beside it
strings.CPU tab: total load with the last minute: CPU tab: total load with the last minute, the busiest processes, per-core load and the last hour
strings.Overview tab: Mac status, CPU, memory an: Overview tab: Mac status, CPU, memory and network tiles, the busiest processes and device tiles
strings.Memory tab: memory used and pressure, th: Memory tab: memory used and pressure, the largest processes, the breakdown and the last hour
strings.**Three readings in one item.** A ring,: **Three readings in one item.** A ring, a center value and a bar. Pick what each shows in Settings, and save combinations as profiles.
strings.**Hover to unfold.** The item opens into: **Hover to unfold.** The item opens into separate readings, and the menu bar items to its left, hidden until then, appear beside it. No Accessibility or Screen Recording access needed.
strings.**Moments.** The item briefly shows what: **Moments.** The item briefly shows what just changed: power connected or on battery, low battery, a new sound output, mute, a drive mounted or removed, the network dropping or returning, a Bluetooth device connecting, or a process staying heavy for minutes. Optional.
strings.Moments in the menu bar: power connected: Moments in the menu bar: power connected, headphones, muted, a drive mounted, a busy process, network unavailable and low battery
strings.Click the item for one tab per area. Eve: Click the item for one tab per area. Every tab has the same layout, top to bottom: notices, the current value and its last minute, the processes using the most, a breakdown, the last hour or day, then the tab's lists and controls.
strings.Mac status (CPU, Memory, Temperature, Di: Mac status (CPU, Memory, Temperature, Disk, GPU, Power), live tiles, busiest processes
strings.Total load, busiest processes, per-core: Total load, busiest processes, per-core load, thermal pressure, history
strings.GPU load, rendering and geometry, GPU me: GPU load, rendering and geometry, GPU memory, processes using the GPU, history
strings.Used and pressure, largest processes, ac: Used and pressure, largest processes, active, wired, compressed, cache, swap, history
strings.Free space, processes writing the most,: Free space, processes writing the most, read and write rates, volumes
strings.Download and upload, processes using the: Download and upload, processes using the network, interfaces, port lookup, history
strings.Charge and time left, power by process,: Charge and time left, power by process, power source, health, what keeps the Mac awake
strings.Network and signal, on/off, nearby netwo: Network and signal, on/off, nearby networks
strings.Modes, resolution and mirroring previews: Modes, resolution and mirroring previews with a 15-second undo, Keep Awake
strings.Battery tab: charge, power use by proces: Battery tab: charge, power use by process, power source, battery health and sleep status
strings.**View All** on any tab opens the Explor: **View All** on any tab opens the Explorer sorted by that tab's measure. Values not measured yet show "—", values macOS doesn't provide show Unavailable, and estimates are marked ≈.
strings.Every process on the Mac, including othe: Every process on the Mac, including other users' and system processes, plus ports and open files.
strings.**Processes or Families**: a flat list o: **Processes or Families**: a flat list or a process tree with totals per family.
strings.**Search** by name, `pid:123`, `uid:501`: **Search** by name, `pid:123`, `uid:501`, `user:root` or `port:3000`. **Show** filters to your processes, other users, system, applications, active or paused.
strings.**Columns** for CPU time, threads, power: **Columns** for CPU time, threads, power, wakeups, disk, GPU, state, kind and start time.
strings.**Inspector** with recent history, power: **Inspector** with recent history, power, GPU, signing, arguments and libraries. Interpreters and build tools show their project, such as `bun · api`.
strings.**Actions**: Pause and Resume, Quit, Ter: **Actions**: Pause and Resume, Quit, Terminate and Force Quit (confirmed), Sample for 3 Seconds, stop the process holding a port, JSON export. Keyboard shortcuts in the **Process** menu.
strings.**Timeline** of sustained CPU, power, me: **Timeline** of sustained CPU, power, memory growth and wakeups, from history.
strings.History stays on the Mac for 24 hours by: History stays on the Mac for 24 hours by default (Off, 24 hours or 7 days in Settings ▸ Privacy) and holds readings and process names only, never paths or arguments.
strings.macOS gives an app exact readings only f: macOS gives an app exact readings only for its own user's processes. Without help, Strata Monitor shows other processes' CPU and memory from Apple's `ps` (marked ≈).
strings.**Show Exact Readings** adds an optional: **Show Exact Readings** adds an optional helper for the rest:
strings.One click where readings are missing, on: One click where readings are missing, one approval by an administrator in System Settings.
strings.Read-only: no file contents, arguments,: Read-only: no file contents, arguments, environment, signals, other tools or writes.
strings.Answers only Strata Monitor signed by th: Answers only Strata Monitor signed by the same team, gives full readings only to administrators, and exits after 30 idle seconds. Turn it off in Settings ▸ Privacy.
strings.No account, tracking, analytics or packe: No account, tracking, analytics or packet capture.
strings.Update checks contact GitHub when you ch: Update checks contact GitHub when you check manually or allow automatic checks. No system readings are sent.
strings.Location (Wi-Fi names) and Bluetooth acc: Location (Wi-Fi names) and Bluetooth access are requested only from their tabs.
strings.Download the [latest release](https://gi: Download the [latest release](https://github.com/cristipufu/strata-monitor/releases/latest) and move Strata Monitor to Applications. Requires an Apple silicon Mac with macOS 26. Releases are signed and notarized.
strings.Build from source with Xcode 26 or Swift: Build from source with Xcode 26 or Swift 6.2:
strings.Use **Check for Updates…** in the Strata: Use **Check for Updates…** in the Strata Monitor menu, or enable daily checks and automatic installation in **Settings ▸ General ▸ Updates**. Updates and the update feed are signed. Automatic installation happens when the app quits.
strings.The app supports 22 languages. Choose on: The app supports 22 languages. Choose one in **Settings ▸ General ▸ Language**, then quit and reopen the app, or use the language selected in macOS. This README is available in English, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Ukrainian, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese.
strings.With any preview: made-up data instead o: With any preview: made-up data instead of this Mac's
strings.With any preview: a fixed appearance: With any preview: a fixed appearance
strings.Writes a study of the menu bar item: Writes a study of the menu bar item
strings.Writes the menu bar unfold animation: Writes the menu bar unfold animation
strings.Previews never change your settings. See: Previews never change your settings. See [docs/IMPLEMENTATION.md](docs/IMPLEMENTATION.md) for the architecture.
strings.Push a tag matching the app version, suc: Push a tag matching the app version, such as `v0.1.0`. The [release workflow](.github/workflows/release.yml) tests, signs, notarizes and publishes a disk image and a zip.
strings.Bug reports, translations and code are w: Bug reports, translations and code are welcome. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for setup and checks, and [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) to report a vulnerability privately.
